findings.title: No consolidated access-control matrix artifact is produced
evidence: tools/full_domain.py aggregate writes no such file
Access rules are spread across the ruleset, CODEOWNERS, workflow permissions and the lab token
findings.impact: Reviewers cannot see the whole authorization model (who may push, which checks are required, who holds the lab token) in one place.
findings.recommendation: Generate access_control_matrix.md from the ruleset/CODEOWNERS/workflow permissions during aggregate.

report: Enumerated access surfaces: GitHub ruleset `main-protection` (id 24481135), workflow `permissions:` blocks, CODEOWNERS routing, and the lab API bearer token. Live state read via `gh api` (no secrets printed).
